title: Kgakgamatso ya Bosupi jo bo Didimetseng
intro: O kopana le kgang e e apesitsweng ke setshwantsho ya go tsereganya ga bomodimo. Kgang ya tlamelo ya kgakgamatso le go iphemela go go senang puo go go boelelang mo nakong. A o ka ribolola gore ke mang yo o neng a lebane le teko eno e e sa tlwaelegang?
clues: Ke ne ka amogela molaetsa wa bomodimo o o neng wa ntlogela ke gakgametse
Batho ba gaetsho ba ne ba belaela bophepa jwa me fa ke boa ke na le ngwana
Ke ne ka laelwa go itima dijo gore ke se ka ka bua ka lobaka lo lo rileng
Motswedi wa metsi le di-date di ne tsa ntshegetsa ka nako ya tsheko ya me
Morena wa me o dirile gore setlhare se reketle ka kgakgamatso go mpha
Moengele mongwe o ne a bonala mo go nna a le mo sebopegong sa monna yo o itekanetseng

outcome.label: Botso
options: Go tlhoka molato ga me go ne ga supiwa fa morwaake wa lesea a ne a bua

Batho ba me ba ne ba senngwa ke kotlhao ya Modimo
Ke gogetse setshaba sa gaetsho kwa phenyong
Sediba sa kgakgamatso se ne sa tlhagelela ruri
outcome.answer: Go tlhoka molato ga me go ne ga supiwa fa morwaake wa lesea a ne a bua

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
